case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 2164-2172 OF 2023; @Special Leave Petition (C) Nos.20781-20789 of 2021

parties.respondent: The State of Jammu And Kashmir & Ors.

summary: Drug Inspector selection process challenge; eligibility criteria modification (55 to 65 points for degree qualifications); universities not affiliated with Pharmacy Council of India; selection committee quorum issues; expert member lacking pharmaceutical qualification; PG candidates' marking anomalies; High Court quashal upheld; appointments since 2009 set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Jammu and Kashmir Subordinate Services Recruitment Rules, 1992
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; appointments quashed.
